title: Through Me First
about: A track about protection, awareness, and stepping in before problems reach others.
description: Through Me First reflects a mindset of taking responsibility and acting early when something feels off. It focuses on reading situations before they fully surface and choosing to step in, even when the line isn’t always clear. The track shows a willingness to take impact, carry weight, and handle problems directly rather than letting them reach others.
lyrics: Verse 1
I catch it before it shows up clear
In the way things shift, in the way it feels
Something’s off, I don’t ignore it
I move fast, I get in front of it
I don’t wait to see how bad it gets
I don’t trust it’ll pass on its own
If it’s coming close, I step between
I shut it down before it grows
Pre-Chorus
I don’t always get where the line should be
Between stepping in and letting things be
But if danger’s close, I won’t hesitate
I’d rather carry it than watch you break
Chorus
If it all comes crashing down tonight
I’ll stand in front, I’ll take the fight
You won’t see how close it ever came
I’ll make sure it stops at me
I can feel the shift before you react
I’m already there before it hits
Let it come, I won’t retreat
If it wants you… it goes through me first
Verse 2
It’s in the pause, it’s in your tone
In the things you don’t say out loud
You try to play it like it’s nothing
But I can see it breaking through
I don’t need you to ask for help
I can tell, I can feel it myself
By the time it shows, I’ve already moved
You don’t see the things I already do
Pre-Chorus
Yeah, I step in before you even know
Fight battles you don’t even realize
But if I’m wrong, I’ll take that blame
If I’m right, you won’t feel the pain
Chorus
If it all comes crashing down tonight
I’ll stand in front, I’ll take the fight
You won’t see how close it ever came
I’ll make sure it stops at me
I can feel the shift before you react
I’m already there before it hits
Let it come, I won’t retreat
If it wants you… it goes through me first
Bridge (soft → powerful)
Yeah, maybe I move before I should
Step in deeper than I probably could
But I’ve seen what happens when no one tries
And I won’t be the one who lets that slide
If I break, I’ll break in your place
If I fall, I’ll still hold the line
Call me reckless, call me insane
But I won’t let you face it alone
Final Chorus (bigger)
If it all comes crashing down tonight
I’ll stand in front, I’ll take the fight
You won’t see how close it ever came
I’ll make sure it stops at me
I can feel the shift before you react
I’m already there before it hits
Let it come, I won’t retreat
If it wants you… it goes through me first
Outro (quiet)
I don’t think twice, I don’t step back
I don’t wait for things to crack
If it comes close, it won’t get far
It ends with me, It’s gotta go through me first
